body.x: Zipshowkorea (CEO Phoenix Hong) participated in CES 2025, held from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, under the Incheon IFEZ Pavilion. Since its founding in 2019, the company has developed solutions that provide immersive experiences through technologies and content like AR, VR, XR, 3D scanning, and interactive media art.

At CES 2025, Zipshowkorea demonstrated its media art platform, "Color to Life," which drew significant attention from attendees. This platform lets users apply their chosen colors and patterns to 3D models on a large screen in real time. Its synesthetic interactive features offer a differentiated, immersive experience and engagement. According to the company, this platform fosters creativity and active participation, particularly among children and adolescents, by providing an enjoyable learning environment.

Color to Life is designed for efficient and straightforward installation and operation. It utilizes a system centered on tablets and software. The system also features data collection and analysis capabilities, capturing users' selected colors, patterns, and character data. This functionality provides clients reliable data to enhance their marketing and services, significantly increasing user satisfaction.

body.cap: Zipshowkorea's representatives introduced the Color to Life platform to AVING News reporter Alex Sigrist at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A representative from Zipshowkorea explained that the company participated in CES 2025 to showcase its innovative content to potential global customers. The company aims to explore partnerships and sales opportunities for international market expansion. The exhibition also allowed the company to observe industry trends and technological advancements, refining its future strategies and strengthening its competitiveness.

The representative further highlighted that Color to Life offers substantial benefits for exhibitions and entertainment businesses that aim to attract families and children. Additionally, it is an appealing option for companies investing in creative learning tools and gamified immersive content that combines education and entertainment.
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
